title: P25: undefined template variable is an error
description: protocol-06 §5.1 directory templates; RFC 6570 §3.2.1 expands an undefined variable to the empty string. Readings: (a) follow RFC 6570, empty expansion; (b) UriTemplate::expand fails with UndefinedVariable. Chosen: (b), fail closed. An empty path segment silently addresses the wrong endpoint. Extends P24 (mimid-1wgh.5.38).
